name: Motion
summary: The animation library for React UIs (the package formerly published as framer-motion). The motion craft reference and several AI components assume it.

steps: npm install motion (the framer-motion package is the predecessor; new projects should use motion).
Import from the React entry: import { motion } from "motion/react".
Existing projects on framer-motion: keep it, the import is import { motion } from "framer-motion" and the API is the same lineage.
Motion principles and restraint guidance live in the motion craft reference (references/motion.md); several of the 109 AI components import motion, and their records list it in dependencies.

files.role: Entrance animation with spring physics, the default motion recipe

notes: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: wrap entrances in useReducedMotion and skip the animation when it is true. The motion craft reference carries the timing and easing guidance, keep animation purposeful.
